title: Tetra: Serving Leech-Lattice Quantized LLMs at 2.7 Bits per Parameter
abstract: arXiv:2609.35465v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Leech-lattice quantization gives good quality at two bits per weight, but its codebooks hold more than 10^14 points, too many for a lookup table. Our earlier kernel expanded the codes at load time and read 4.804 bits per weight from GPU memory for 2 bits of code. We present Tetra, a new codebook on the same lattice. A 24-weight block still takes 48 bits, most of which index a 64-state trellis of the Golay code and one shared 16 KiB table. The kernel decodes a block with six table loads and two small lookups inside the matrix-vector product, and reads 2.148 bits per weight. For full models, we retrain one scale per matrix row, store the matrices that lose the most as 4-bit integers, and pay for them with 4-bit embedding tables. Our Qwen3-4B, 8B and 14B files hold 2.73, 2.70 and 2.73 bits per parameter over the whole model. They score 63.37, 69.58 and 75.66 on the full MMLU test set, 4.76, 4.21 and 2.46 points below 4-bit AWQ at 5.3 to

translated_title: Tetra：以每参数2.7比特部署Leech格量化的大语言模型
translated_abstract: Leech格量化在每权重2比特的情况下能提供良好的模型质量，但其码本包含超过10^14个点，数量太多而无法用查找表实现。我们之前的内核在加载时展开码字，为2比特的代码需从GPU内存读取每权重4.804比特。我们提出Tetra，这是同一格上的一个新码本。一个24权重的块仍然占用48比特，其中大部分用于索引Golay码的64状态网格图和一个共享的16 KiB表。内核在矩阵向量乘积内部通过六次表加载和两次小型查找解码一个块，每权重仅读取2.148比特。对于完整模型，我们为每个矩阵行重新训练一个缩放因子，将损失最大的矩阵存储为4比特整数，并用4比特嵌入表来补偿其开销。我们的Qwen3-4B、8B和14B模型文件在整个模型上分别保持每参数2.73、2.70和2.73比特。它们在完整MMLU测试集上的得分分别为63.37、69.58和75.66，比4比特AWQ低4.76、4.21和2.46分。
tldr: Tetra通过在Leech格上设计基于Golay码64状态网格图的新码本和高效解码内核，将每权重读取量从4.804比特降至2.148比特，实现了整模型每参数约2.7比特的高质量大语言模型量化部署。
en_tdlr: Tetra introduces a new Leech-lattice codebook built on a 64-state trellis of the Golay code, enabling GPU kernels to read only 2.148 bits per weight instead of 4.804, and delivering full Qwen3 models quantized at roughly 2.7 bits per parameter with moderate accuracy loss compared to 4-bit AWQ.
